_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With 0 of 35 recent 12h windows producing a ±2+ point move, the statistically honest call is HOLD at Denial until either ETF flow continuation pushes Disbelief or a VIX spike above 20 drives a Panic retest — forcing direction in a 0% volatility coil is how the record went 0-for-18.
next_move.brains_agree: Split — analyst calls UP with low conviction toward Hope (two rungs forward, which violates the ±1 rule from Denial so effectively targets Anxiety at best); narrative implies UP resolution but doesn't specify phase; judge overrides both to HOLD based on base-rate evidence
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC funding rises above 0.01% with price holding $64K+ and VIX below 16, or ETF flows sustain 90+ for 48h — this confirms transition to Anxiety (39-46) and justifies UP
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX breaks 20 with DXY rallying above 101 and BTC loses $62K on expanding volume, or fed_liquidity pinned at 0 with exchange reserves spiking above 95 — this drops to Panic (24-31)
